name: Courier Desk
summary: A courier and cash-on-delivery desk in PKR: a live hub map, a rolling cash counter and seller payouts
about: A nine-page desk for Wagtail Parcels, a made-up courier with hubs in Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, Faisalabad and Multan. A dot map of Pakistan shows parcels moving between the hubs, and a cash counter rolls up as riders collect cash on delivery. Bookings with live pricing and labels, parcel tracking, riders and run sheets, line haul, seller payouts, returns, claims and reports all work and keep their data in the browser.
how: Open a page from the top bar: Overview, Bookings, Parcels, Riders, Hubs, COD, Returns, Reports or Settings
Watch parcels move on the hub map and the cash counter roll; tap a hub to light up its lanes
Book a parcel: the price updates as you type, then print its label with a barcode
Track a parcel by number, add the next scan, record a failed attempt or start a return
Open a rider run sheet, mark stops delivered, collect their cash and pay sellers in one batch
Drag claims across the board, build a report and export it as CSV
Press Ctrl+K to jump anywhere, and reset the demo data in Settings
